title: A Gravity for the Archive
author: Quentin Thornbury
blurb: Tamsin Zhou, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
